question: Does the codebase propagator's quaternion convention match SPICE pxform, and does the s062b L_J2000 puzzle reduce to an omega-sign residual?
hypothesis: The propagator q-interpretation is correct but its kinematic ODE carries the opposite sign of the textbook passive-J2000->body convention.
narrative_md: The s062b convention puzzle is resolved against SPICE on a real IS-901 epoch: the propagator's q-interpretation matches pxform('J2000', body, et) to 3e-16 at t=0, but feeding the textbook body-frame omega makes R drift at ~2e-4 per second while feeding -omega closes it to 9.7e-11 per second. So the kinematic ODE carries a hidden minus sign vs the textbook passive-J2000->body convention; cached omega0_rad is the negation of the physical body-frame angular velocity. Diagnosed as a bookkeeping residual, internally consistent across the cohort. Uses SPICE, not m048 truth -- genuinely blind. (Later superseded by s066: the residual does NOT extend to LC duration.)
